title.narrative: Environmentally Sound Management and Final Disposal of Polychlorinated Biphenyls (PCBs)

description.narrative: .The proposed project will establish an environmentally sound management (ESM) system for PCBs, improve compliance to PCBs related obligations under the Stockholm Convention (SC) and promote local use of non-combustion technologies in the disposal of 3,000 tons of PCBs contaminated equipment.
